Bots work right in Slack like any teammate. Ask them questions, hand them work, or loop them into a thread.

They take projects from start to end, learn how your team works, and check in when your approval is needed.

## FAQs

### How is Grok Bot different from AI assistants?

Most AI assistants are built for one person. Grok Bot is an AI teammate the whole team works with. Bots have their own computer, so they work inside your apps and tools, and they run in parallel, 24/7, even when your laptop is closed.

### Can my whole team work with the same Bot?

Yes. Share a Bot with your team, and anyone can ask it questions, hand it work, or loop it into a thread.

### Where can I work with Grok Bot?

Wherever your team already works. Message Bots in the Grok Bot app on desktop and iOS, bring them into Slack and Microsoft Teams, or add them to your Google Meet, Zoom, or Teams calls.

### Can Bots join my meetings?

Yes. Add a Bot to a Google Meet, Zoom, or Teams call. It listens in, jumps into the chat when it can help, and follows through after.

### How much does Grok Bot cost?

Grok Bot subscriptions come with weekly usage included, with additional usage billed based on token cost. Enterprise customers should [contact sales](https://cursor.com/contact-sales?product=grok-bot).

### Is Grok Bot available for enterprises?

Yes. Grok Bot is generally available for Enterprise, as well as for teams on the Teams plan. [Contact sales](https://cursor.com/contact-sales?product=grok-bot) to set up Enterprise access for your organization, including people who don’t already have a seat.

### How does Grok Bot handle my data & privacy?

Grok Bot uses the same Cursor SSO, auth, and privacy mode you already trust. Your cloud computer is encrypted in transit and at rest, with training opt-out. Sensitive actions can go through Auto Review before they run. Enterprise admins can set DLP, certs, proxies, and network controls at boot.
